The '''Shaylin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], located on the [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaylin 18]].
